comments.body:
## Design review
Full meeting notes can be found here: https://github.com/canonical-web-and-design/meeting-notes/issues/386

- Can we hide the subscribe form? Keep it simple with a button or link that opens the form
- Links should live together, _Legal should live together_, _Sign-up should live together_, _Social should live together_?
- 'We're hiring!' should be 'Careers' so it's consistent with the rest of our suite of sites
- 001 layout preferred 
- Good use of white space
- Keep Vanilla 'Back to top' link

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
## Updated exploration
Taking feedback above into consideration for a design update.
- @therealjuan @spencerbygraves ready for review

We can probably get away with no check-box and privacy notice message and...

Instead of `Newsletter signup / Email *` in two lines use a single field `Get new articles on your inbox`
